files.README.md:
# Larkmeadow Environmental Services - depot workspace

Working area for the collections depot office.

- services/  the day each waste stream is collected

Each waste stream is collected on one day of the week and the round sheet is edited in place, so a stream is never listed on two days. Streams are kept in the order they were added to the collection contract. Last reviewed 2025-11-03, reference LE-2205.

turns.prompt: A dental surgery has joined the Larkmeadow Environmental Services round and the depot has to tell its manager when clinical waste is collected. Which day of the week is it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
